# DegenView

> DegenView is a free, open source TradingView alternative for the desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux). It has multi-chart layouts for crypto, stocks and prediction markets, a local Pine Script v6 engine, alerts with webhooks, bar replay, strategy backtesting, paper trading, portfolio tracking and an optional MCP server for AI assistants. No account is needed. Licensed GPL-3.0-only.

DegenView is an independent project and is not affiliated with TradingView.

## Pages
- [Home](https://degenview.app/): overview and feature tour
- [Pine Studio](https://degenview.app/pine-studio/): the Pine Script v6 editor with a step debugger, profiler, strategy backtesting, AI assistant and editor themes
- [TradingView alternative](https://degenview.app/tradingview-alternative/): how DegenView compares with TradingView, including what TradingView does better
- [Download](https://degenview.app/download/): installers for macOS, Windows and Linux
- [FAQ](https://degenview.app/faq/): accounts, data sources, Pine Script, platforms
- [Support](https://degenview.app/support/): ways to support the project: buy a coffee, crypto, star on GitHub, share, report bugs, contribute
- [Docs](https://docs.degenview.app/): user guide covering markets, charts, drawing tools, Pine Studio, alerts, paper trading, portfolio and the MCP server
- [Privacy policy](https://degenview.app/privacy-policy/): cookies and analytics

## Languages
The site is available in English (default), Spanish, German, French, Hindi and Simplified Chinese. Each page has the same path under a language prefix.
- [English](https://degenview.app/)
- [Español](https://degenview.app/es/)
- [Deutsch](https://degenview.app/de/)
- [Français](https://degenview.app/fr/)
- [हिन्दी](https://degenview.app/hi/)
- [简体中文](https://degenview.app/zh/)

## App languages
The app's interface is available in English, Spanish, German, Russian and Simplified Chinese. How to switch: https://docs.degenview.app/workspace/language
